summary: Tasklio iteration 4 (frontend-only, Expo web preview, 390x844) — all 8 requested changes + regression pass end-to-end. (1) Quiz Time: answering all 5 as wrong reaches the SHARED GameResult overlay (testID 'game-result') with 'No points this time' text at 'game-result-points'; 'game-result-play-again' restarts the quiz and 'game-result-home' returns to /home. (2) No '+0' history: verified via localStorage — before quiz txns=0, after 0-pt quiz txns=0 (earnPoints skips txn when points===0). (3) Home header compact: 'Hii, Alta Tester' greeting + subtext 'Let's earn some rewards today' both render; menu, points badge, and bell all present with tight spacing (single row, no gaps). (4) Games row: exactly the 9 remaining tiles present (home-game-spin/puzzle/quiz/ttt/hilo/whack/math/n2048/mine); 4.5 tiles visible at once in 390px viewport (screenshot confirms Mine Pick tile clipped on the right); deleted tiles absent (tap/lucky/snake/balloon/higher). Direct navigation to /games/tap-race, /games/lucky, /games/snake, /games/balloon, /games/higher-card ALL hit Expo Router's 'Unmatched Route' screen. (5) Daily Check-in: for fresh account 'home-checkin-card' + 'home-checkin-claim' visible, Day 1 of 7; clicking Claim opens GameResult popup with '+10 points earned'; after dismissing popup the checkin card is HIDDEN (canClaimCheckin false) and localStorage points=10, txns=1. (6) Drawer Restricted Area: computed opacity=0.45 (faded); SINGLE tap does not open dialog; DOUBLE tap within 400ms opens 'access-key-dialog'; wrong key ('wrongkey') → 'thanks-dialog' visible with 'thanks-close' present; correct key '9372@Altaf93Tasklio' → navigates to /admin. (7) Admin (/admin): 'Admin Panel' header + Adjust points / Manage payouts / User profile / Send custom notification sections ALL present; 'Change admin PIN', 'Backup', 'Export', 'Import', 'Reset app' NONE present. (8) Old /restricted route removed — shows Unmatched Route. Regression: create-account flow works, /wallet renders with 'wallet-tab-activity' and 'wallet-tab-payouts' tabs and payout request card.

critical_code_review_comments: quiz.tsx (lines 52-56): final result is computed as `correct + (isRight ? 1 : 0)` at the terminal question so the last click is counted correctly; earnPoints is invoked once regardless of points; setResult opens the shared GameResult overlay. Good.
game-result.tsx (line 43): '+N points earned' vs 'No points this time' branching is correct; overlay uses zIndex 50 with absolute fill so it correctly covers the quiz body.
app-store.tsx earnPoints (line 234): `points !== 0` guard skips the txn entry — matches requirement verified in localStorage.

app-store.tsx canClaimCheckin/nextCheckinDay + claimDailyCheckin (lines 79-86, 238-249): streak progresses only if lastClaim === yesterday, else resets to Day 1; today's claim writes lastClaim=todayKey which hides the card.
drawer-menu.tsx (lines 48-57): double-tap threshold is 400ms via `lastTap` ref — verified visually. Restricted row has opacity: 0.45 baked into styles (line 213).
drawer-menu.tsx submitKey (lines 59-69): correct key routes to /admin via router.push (not replace) so back button works. Wrong key opens the innocuous thanks dialog with no error surface.
admin.tsx: fully cleaned — no PIN input, no Backup/Restore/Export/Import section, no reset button. Verified via body text scrape.
games.ts: GAMES array is exactly the 9 approved games; deleted games removed and their files removed from /app/frontend/app/games/ (verified by ls).
Note: app-store.tsx still exports setAdminPin/resetAll/exportBackup/importBackup and keeps `adminPin: '1234'` in seedState() — dead code post-cleanup (see action item).
